newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank to publish overnight AIBOR rate.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank to publish overnight AIBOR rate.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said on Friday it would publish an overnight Amsterdam Interbank Offered Rate (AIBOR) from Monday, February 3.
"The market (banks) have requested an overnight rate, alongside the other Amsterdam interbank offered rates we already publish," a central bank spokesman said.
The central bank said the market needed an overnight AIBOR rate for business related to index-swaps and other derivatives.
AIBOR rates are published on the Dutch central bank's AIBO page on the Reuters system.
The spokesman said one possible drawback was that money market players seek to do call business (overnight money market transactions) at the new AIBOR overnight rate.
He said the new rate had not been created for this purpose although the money market might well want to refer to it as a sort of benchmark for call money business.
"The Dutch central bank is a neutral institution. We are only publishing the new overnight AIBOR rate because the market demanded such a move," the spokesman said.
